For each of F, Q, and P, reject only when a case value is greater than the selected value beyond tolerance, and separately require that at least one of the four corresponding case values matches the selected maximum within a tolerance scaled from the expected selected result (not from the reported case value); equality with one or more cases must pass. Keep this as a bounded direct-arithmetic maximum check. Also correct the final seven-eighths midpoint tolerance expression to use the same expected-result scaling form as the other three midpoint checks, and ensure the four distinct calculation cases are thereby matched to the four expected midpoint positions so equal subdivision is established.
